newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to open Taiwan dollar options by June.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to open Taiwan dollar options by June.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank and finance ministry have reached an agreement to open trading in local dollar options by the end of June in a bid to expand the domestic foreign exchange market, officials said on Thursday.
The move will offer trading options for Taiwan companies and investors in exchanges between Taiwan dollar and other foreign currencies.
Taiwan has already allowed foreign exchange options trading between foreign currencies.
Taiwan, which started financial derivatives trading in early 1994, so far allows more than 10 derivatives to be traded, including cross-currency swaps, margin, option and interest rate swap trading.
